summary: Get one booking type by uuid
Update a booking type
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Absent keeps; a child list that is sent replaces that list (items that carry an id keep their rows). Pausing is `isActive: false`.

summary: Remove the override of one date
Close a date, or give it special hours
description: Adds or replaces the override of one date (YYYY-MM-DD in the type's zone) and leaves everything else alone.

summary: Back to the workspace look
description: Deletes the override and its pictures.

summary: One service's booking page override, with the look it inherits
Save one service's override
description: Colours, cover style, welcome text and button label only; empty fields inherit the workspace theme. Needs the rowVersion you read (null when nothing was saved).

summary: Remove this service's logo or cover image
Upload this service's logo or cover image
Send a step as a test email to the signed-in user's own address, or to one address they type
description: Email only (there is no WhatsApp test). Sample values; the subject starts with [Test]. `to` is optional (default: the signed-in user). At most 10 tests per workspace per hour (429). The worker sends it and the result arrives as a notification. 404 when the step does not belong to the service.

summary: The open slots of a type, as the customer sees them
description: From / to are local dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the type's time zone, at most 62 days (default 14 from today). Only days with an open slot appear.

summary: Contact groups and segments with their member counts (step 2)
How many contacts the audience selects, and how many are skipped (opted out, invalid number)
description: The same evaluation the launch writes its recipients from: groups and segments joined, narrowed by the rules. `approximate` is true when the database could not count in time.

summary: Broadcasts made by the wizard (one-off campaigns and recurring series), newest first
Delete a launched broadcast, or a recurring series that has not sent anything yet
description: A one-off broadcast goes with its recipients. A series goes with the runs it had planned, only while none of them has sent a message (409 `CAMP_SERIES_HAS_HISTORY` otherwise: cancel it instead).

summary: One broadcast with its schedule, runs and retry summary
Cancel a broadcast, or a recurring series and what it has started
Download the recipients of a launched broadcast as CSV (a series: every run, with a Run column)
Pause a scheduled or running broadcast, or a recurring series
Resume a paused broadcast or series
Send again to the recipients that failed (a series: in every finished run)
The contacts table of the audience step: search, conditions, page and total
description: Searched and filtered on the server (the conditions are compiled by the segments rule engine). A POST because the conditions are a tree; it writes nothing.

summary: Balance, estimated cost for this template and these countries, and whether the wallet allows the send
Upload a CSV of numbers for "Broadcast via CSV": parsed, validated and stored for this workspace
description: Form fields: `file`, and optionally `options` (JSON: consentConfirmed, consentNoticeText, consentNoticeVersion; the uploader confirms they hold consent for the numbers, which are then granted when the broadcast launches). Numbers are normalised to E.164, repeated numbers kept once, invalid rows reported with their line. Nothing is written to the contacts: numbers that are not contacts yet become contacts when the broadcast is launched. 422 CON_IMPORT_FILE_INVALID, 413 CON_IMPORT_TOO_LARGE.

summary: A CSV template for "Broadcast via CSV" (a phone column, optional names)
A stored CSV upload: counts, preview and the first rejected rows
The rows of a CSV upload that cannot be used, with line numbers, as a CSV
Start a broadcast draft (saved as the person goes, listed with the campaigns)
Read a draft, to resume the wizard
Save a draft
description: Takes whatever is filled in so far. 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT when the draft moved, 409 CAMP_WIZARD_LAUNCHED once it was launched.

summary: Launch the draft: now, at a date and time, or as a recurring series
description: Every step is checked again. 422 CAMP_WIZARD_INCOMPLETE (errors[] name the step), 422 WALLET_EMPTY, 422 CAMP_NO_RECIPIENTS, 422 CAMP_TEMPLATE_NOT_ALLOWED, 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT.

summary: The test messages sent for a draft, newest first, with their delivery and charge
Broadcast runs for the History (every run, newest first) and Scheduled (waiting, soonest first) pages
Connected WhatsApp numbers a broadcast can be sent from (step 1)
Approved templates a broadcast can use, with their placeholders (step 1)
Send the draft as a test WhatsApp message to up to ten numbers
description: 422 CAMP_TEST_RECIPIENTS_INVALID for a number that is not E.164, WALLET_EMPTY when the wallet cannot cover it. Tracking is off; the wallet charges when the delivery is reported.

summary: The message resolved for a few real contacts, and the placeholders still unmapped
List broadcasts, newest first, filtered by status, range and name
Create a broadcast (now or scheduled), one row per picked sender
description: Checks, in order: plan feature and cap (422 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED / PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED), the body (400 VALIDATION_FAILED), an audience of at least one sendable contact (422 BCAST_NO_RECIPIENTS), send policy and wallet (422 BCAST_SEND_BLOCKED), the template (422 BCAST_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND / BCAST_TEMPLATE_NOT_ALLOWED) and the warmer (422 BCAST_WARMER_HOLD). The body is validated after the plan checks, as Reference did.

summary: What the compose page opens with: approved templates and connected sending numbers (`?channel=sms` for the SMS card)
The tiles and status counts above the list (whole workspace, ignores the list filter)
Delete a scheduled or failed broadcast and its recipients
description: 422 BCAST_NOT_DELETABLE for any other status; a queued job for it is withdrawn.

summary: One broadcast: header numbers, template, sender, charts data and events
Download the recipients as CSV (streamed)
Live counters for polling; `inFlight` turns false when the broadcast is over
Recipients of a broadcast, newest first, filtered by status and name or phone
Resume a paused broadcast where it stopped
description: 409 BCAST_NOT_RESUMABLE unless the broadcast is paused. Unsent recipients are still pending, so nobody is messaged twice.

summary: Put the failed recipients back to pending and send them again
description: 409 BCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE while the broadcast is running or waiting; 422 BCAST_NO_FAILED_RECIPIENTS when nothing failed. Delivered recipients are never messaged again.

summary: Sent, delivered, read, failed, processing and queued counts
Director summary of a broadcast: people messaged, delivered, read, wrote back, filled a form
The people behind a broadcast summary figure
Current billing mode, whether reseller billing is available, and each number credit line
Choose meta_direct or reseller
description: reseller flips the workspace to wallet billing and attaches the platform credit line to each connected number; the response says how each attach went. meta_direct only flips the flag.

summary: The call log: a page of calls, Reference’s four totals and the totals of the selection
description: Filters: range (24h, 7d, 30d) or from/to days in tz, status, direction, source, numberId, agentId, q (a phone number or part of the contact name). Every source is read without the plan feature waba_calling; numberId (a WhatsApp number) needs it, else 422 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED.

summary: Calls over time, answered rate, by teammate, by hour of the week, average handle time
The numbers and teammates the filter bar offers
description: The WhatsApp numbers are listed only when the workspace has the plan feature waba_calling (else an empty list); the teammates are those of every source.

summary: One call with its timeline and whether it has a recording
A link that plays the recording for a few minutes (audited each time)
description: Needs call.recordings.play as well and the plan feature waba_calling (422 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED without it). 404 when the call has no recording.

summary: Place or lift a legal hold on a recording
description: A held recording is skipped by the retention sweep and refuses a manual delete. A reason is required to place a hold; both are audited.

summary: Place a call
description: Permission first: with no usable grant a request is sent instead and the answer is 422 CALL_PERMISSION_REQUESTED. Opus-only SDP offer.

summary: Calls ringing now (inbound, last two minutes)
Answer a ringing call (409 CALL_STATE_CONFLICT when a teammate took it first)
Has the customer picked up? Meta's SDP answer once they have
Delete the recording of a call (the call stays)
description: 409 CALL_RECORDING_ON_HOLD while a legal hold is on.

summary: The recording of a call
Upload the operator's recording of a call (up to 50 MB)
Record the person's answer to being recorded (granted or declined)
description: Only while the call is live. A decline after a file was stored removes it. 422 CALL_RECORDING_DISABLED, CALL_RECORDING_CONSENT_INVALID.

summary: May this call be recorded? The ConsentGate answer with the notice
Decline a ringing call
Hang up (or cancel a call still ringing)
note: skipped: would invalidate the test session or change credentials

summary: Whether the Call button shows for a conversation, and whether the customer allowed calls
The operator's ICE servers (STUN and TURN) for the browser's call
description: From CALLING_ICE_SERVERS; an empty list means the four public STUN servers.

summary: The WhatsApp numbers with their calling switch
One number's calling readiness checklist, as of its last check
Check a number now: asks Meta, keeps the result, and brings the switch in line with Meta
description: Adds the calls webhook field to the platform Meta app when it is missing and the app has a callback. Never switches calling on.

summary: Switch calling on or off for a number
description: Meta's own setting; the local flags change only after Meta accepts. 422 CALL_COEXISTENCE_UNSUPPORTED, CALL_META_REFUSED (in words).

summary: Ask the customer for permission to call them
Every WhatsApp number with its calling readiness checklist (as of its last check)
description: Codes, never sentences. Works without the plan feature: the checklist then says so and Meta is not asked.

summary: The workspace's call recording rules (off by default), with the notice to read out
Set the call recording rules: switch, consent mode, retention days, notice text
description: rowVersion is required after the first save. Each changed notice text is a new version. 422 CALL_RECORDING_SETTINGS_INVALID, 409 on a stale rowVersion.

summary: Whether calling is switched on by itself after a number is connected
Switch calling on by itself after a number is connected (off by default)
description: rowVersion is required after the first save. Needs the plan feature waba_calling. 409 on a stale rowVersion.

summary: Would a call to this contact or number be allowed? (asked before dialling)
description: A marketing call to a number on the Do-Not-Call list, or to someone who withdrew, answers deny. Places nothing. Logging the call afterwards is allowed whatever this says.

summary: Ask the workspace telephony provider to ring you, then the customer
description: The finished call is logged by the provider callback (source web_click_to_call). 422 CONSENT_OPTED_OUT with reason on_dnc_list for a marketing call to a Do-Not-Call number.

summary: The mobile app reports up to 100 calls
description: Idempotent on (deviceId, deviceCallId). A number that matches no contact is not stored unless the workspace creates contacts from unknown callers. Each entry answers on its own.

summary: Log a call that was not a WhatsApp call
description: Needs the contact or the phone number. Optionally makes a follow-up task and returns a lifecycle stage suggestion (never applied). Logging is never refused by a consent rule.

summary: Delete a call you logged, while the workspace edit window is open
Edit a call you logged, while the workspace edit window is open
description: A call reported by a phone or a provider cannot be edited. 409 on a stale rowVersion.

summary: The workspace call logging rules
Change the workspace call logging rules (rowVersion after the first save)
The workspace telephony connections
Add a telephony connection
description: Answers the callback secret ONCE; the provider signs its callbacks with it.

summary: Remove a telephony connection (the calls it reported stay)
Rename, re-number, enable or disable a telephony connection
Make a new callback secret (shown once); the old one stops working
The telephony providers a connection can use
The campaigns with filters, tiles, status counts and health cards
description: Counts come from the recipient rows. A campaign whose recipients are all resolved is finished by this call.

summary: Create a campaign and, for "send now", start it
description: The audience is the union of contactIds, groupIds, tagIds, typed numbers and an uploaded CSV. 422 CAMP_NO_RECIPIENTS when nobody is on it (unless the status is draft), CAMP_TEMPLATE_NOT_ALLOWED for a template that cannot be campaigned, CAMP_EXPIRY_BEFORE_SEND when the end date is not after the send date.

summary: Draft a campaign (name, message, footer, call to action, quick replies) from a brief
description: 422 CAMP_AI_NO_KEY when no key is active for the vendor; 422 CAMP_AI_LIMIT_REACHED when the monthly allowance on the platform's key is used; 502 CAMP_AI_PROVIDER_FAILED when the vendor fails or answers nothing; 422 CAMP_AI_BAD_JSON when the answer is not the expected JSON. Nothing is stored.

summary: Draw one picture for a campaign from a brief and store it as a marketing upload
description: 422 CAMP_AI_NO_KEY when no key is active for the vendor; 422 CAMP_AI_LIMIT_REACHED when the monthly allowance on the platform's key is used; 422 CAMP_AI_IMAGE_REFUSED when the vendor's safety system refuses the prompt; 502 CAMP_AI_PROVIDER_FAILED when the vendor fails or returns nothing; 422 when the workspace storage is local (the file must be reachable by the provider).

summary: Senders, templates, groups, tags and flows for the builder
Delete several campaigns of this workspace and their recipients
A sample recipients CSV: name, country_code, phone (channel=email: name, email)
The forms a director can pick as "an application" for the campaign summary
description: Web forms and WhatsApp forms of the workspace; a kind is listed only to a caller who may read forms.

summary: Delete a campaign and its recipients, in any status
The detail page: rates, funnel, charts, preview, audience, failures, replies
Edit a draft, scheduled or paused campaign
description: 422 CAMP_NOT_EDITABLE for any other status. An audience that is sent and not empty replaces the recipients.

summary: Cancel: the run stops at its next recipient
The whole campaign for the edit form, with its recipient contacts
Download the recipients as CSV (streamed, newest first)
Live stats: the counts, rates, queued and processing numbers the detail page polls
description: Recounted from the recipient rows on every call. `inFlight` is true while the campaign is scheduled or running; the page stops asking when it is false.

summary: The recipient log, 50 a page, with a status filter and a search
Send a finished campaign again: to the failed (default), all, or selected recipients
description: 422 CAMP_NOT_RESENDABLE unless completed, failed or cancelled; 422 CAMP_NOTHING_TO_RESEND when nobody matches. Only the targeted recipients are reset.

summary: Resume: the unsent recipients go on where the run stopped
Send now: the schedule becomes now and the run starts
Statistics: where every recipient is now, the funnel figures and the campaign timeline
description: `breakdown` counts each recipient once at its status, so it adds up to `total`; `counts` and `rates` are the cumulative funnel (a read message is also delivered and sent).

summary: Director summary: people messaged, delivered, read, wrote back, filled a form
description: Distinct people, not messages. `cameBackDays` is 3, 7 or 14; `formIds` limits which forms count. Cached for a minute. `filledForm` is null without `record.form-submissions.read`.

summary: The people behind a summary figure: came_back, filled_form or not_reached
description: Keyset page, 100 at most. `filled_form` needs `record.form-submissions.read`. Names and numbers are what the recipients tab already shows.

summary: The Activity tab: the latest catalog sends, newest first
description: One row per recipient attempt (sent and failed), 50 by default, up to 100.

summary: Link the catalog from the connected WABA number
description: Uses the stored WABA token: the catalog id of the WABA config, else the first catalog Meta lists for the WABA, else a new catalog created and linked (when a business id is known). 422 CAT_NO_WABA, CAT_WABA_TOKEN_MISSING, CAT_NO_CATALOG_LINKED, CAT_META_REJECTED.

summary: Save the order acknowledgement and concierge settings
description: A missing flag is false, a blank text null. Keys without a control (concierge footer, acknowledgement template id) are kept. 404 when no catalog.

summary: The collections with their products, plus the picker list
description: Newest first. `pickProducts` are the first 300 active products by name.

summary: Create a collection
description: 1 to 30 product ids; ids that are not this workspace's are dropped and the submitted order is kept; none left is 422 CAT_COLLECTION_PRODUCTS_INVALID. The slug is made unique per workspace.

summary: Delete a collection
description: The products are untouched; its Meta product set is deleted too when it was pushed. Deleting one that is already gone succeeds.

summary: Replace a collection
description: The slug is regenerated only when the name changed. `rowVersion` is optional; when sent, a stale one is 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT.

summary: Remove the collection's product set from Meta
description: The collection stays. A set already gone on Meta counts as removed.

summary: Push the collection to Meta as a product set
description: Creates the product set (or updates the one pushed before) holding the active members by retailer id. 422 CAT_NOT_CONNECTED, CAT_SET_NOT_SYNCABLE (no active products), CAT_META_REJECTED.

summary: Show the catalog button and enable the cart (pushed to Meta, then stored)
description: 404 when no catalog; 422 CAT_NO_PHONE_NUMBER without a phone number id; 422 CAT_META_REJECTED with Meta's message (the stored flags are unchanged).

summary: Connect a Meta Cloud or 360dialog catalog
description: The credentials are verified against Meta first and saved (encrypted) only when Meta accepts them: 422 CAT_META_REJECTED carries Meta's message, code and the catalog_management hint; 422 CAT_PROVIDER_FAILED when Meta could not be reached. Re-connecting a provider replaces its row and keeps the automation settings.

summary: Create a new catalog on Meta and connect it
description: Creates the catalog under the connected WABA's business, links it to the WABA and connects it here. 422 CAT_ALREADY_CONNECTED when a catalog is connected; 422 CAT_NO_WABA, CAT_WABA_TOKEN_MISSING, CAT_NO_CATALOG_LINKED (no business id); 422 CAT_META_REJECTED with Meta's message (nothing is saved).

summary: Delete the catalog on Meta and disconnect it
description: Irreversible on Meta. `confirmCatalogId` must equal the connected catalog id (422 CAT_CONFIRM_MISMATCH). After Meta accepts, the catalog is disconnected here like POST /catalog/disconnect. 404 with no catalog; 422 CAT_META_REJECTED.

summary: Disconnect the catalog
description: Removes the binding and forgets every product's sync state (the retailer ids are kept). Nothing is removed from Meta. Succeeds when there is no catalog.

summary: Import the products of the Meta catalog
description: Up to 2000 products. Existing rows (by retailer id) are updated, new ones created, all marked synced. A row without retailer id or name is skipped. 422 CAT_NOT_CONNECTED or Meta's own error.

summary: The Meta app and configuration for the catalog login popup
The Setup tab in one read
description: The catalog (null when none is connected; the access token is never part of it), shops, sync counts by status, the 50 most recently changed products, the health score with up to 8 products to fix, the 5 latest sends and the connected senders.

summary: Refresh the status of the pending batches
description: Pending products become synced or failed (with Meta's message); batches Meta still works on stay pending. 422 CAT_NOT_CONNECTED; 502 when Meta cannot be asked.

summary: List products (cursor paginated, 25 by default)
description: Reference's order: sort order, then newest. `q` matches name or SKU (case-insensitive, this workspace only). `includeTotal=true` adds `meta.total` for numbered pages.

summary: Create a product
description: The slug comes from the name and is made unique per workspace. A prices is entered in major units ("1299.50") and stored x100. With a Meta catalog connected an active product is pushed after the save; a Meta failure never fails the save (the product shows `failed`).

summary: Active, in-stock products for the inbox, chat and Send tab pickers
description: At most 120, in the list's order. `q` matches name or SKU. `shopId` keeps that shop's products and the ones that belong to no shop.

summary: Delete a product
description: A hard delete (Reference soft-deleted); its reviews and stock holds go with it. Nothing is removed from Meta.

summary: Get one product by uuid
Replace a product
description: Needs the `rowVersion` you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). The slug does not change. A change to a catalog-relevant field pushes the product to Meta after the save.

summary: Send one product (image and caption) to a WhatsApp number
description: Goes through the connected device; needs no Meta catalog. 422 for a number under 7 digits (VALIDATION_FAILED) or no connected device (CAT_NO_SENDER); 502 CAT_SEND_FAILED when the device refuses.

summary: The shop page of the product and a wa.me link with a ready order text
description: `publicUrl` is null without a shop, `waLink` null without a sender number.

summary: Rename the catalog on Meta
description: Meta is asked first and the stored name changes only when Meta accepts. 404 with no catalog; 422 CAT_META_REJECTED.

summary: Reviews of one status, newest first (cursor paginated, 30 by default)
description: `status` is pending, approved or rejected; anything else reads as pending. `meta.counts` has the three totals for the tabs.

summary: Delete a review
description: A review that is already gone succeeds, as in Reference.

summary: Approve, reject or move a review back to pending
Send a catalog message (single product, product list or catalog link) to up to 500 numbers
description: Recipients are pasted numbers, contacts and contact groups, de-duplicated. A workspace with a Meta catalog sends through Meta whatever the sender; without one, a carousel or the shop link goes through the connected device. The reply is 200 even when every recipient failed (`ok` is false then); rule failures are 422 CAT_NO_RECIPIENTS, CAT_TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS, CAT_NO_PRODUCTS, CAT_NO_SENDER, CAT_NO_SHOP.

summary: What the Send tab needs: senders, shops, contact groups, contacts, recent sends
description: Contacts are the 500 newest (or the 500 newest matching `q`, a name or number search). `connected` is false when no sender exists and the tab shows "Connect a device first".

summary: Push one chunk (at most 1000) of active products to Meta
description: With `productIds`: exactly those that are active. Without: the products never pushed or failed. Call again while `hasMore`. 422 CAT_NOT_CONNECTED; 502 when Meta refuses the batch (the chunk is marked failed).

summary: Connected channels with their capabilities (no secrets)
Create the dev-only simulated channel (flag on, never in production)
Remove a channel with no conversations
One channel
Rename, switch on or off, change settings
Live health check of the provider account
description: Reads the number (name, quality, messaging limit, status), the account and the webhook subscription from the provider with the connected number's credentials, stores the snapshot on the channel and answers with it. A refused token moves the channel to `needs_reauth`; a passing check on a linked number brings it back. A failed check is an answer with `ok: false`, not an error.

summary: Announcements live right now, in display order
List companies (cursor paginated)
description: Newest first by default (sort=name for A to Z, sort=property&sortKey=<property key> by a company property, sortDir=asc|desc). Filters: q (substring of the name), ownerId, unassigned, industry, hasOpenDeals, props (a JSON array of conditions on company properties, in the operators of segment rules). Every row carries its rollup: contact count, deal counts and open / won value per currency (null for a kind the caller cannot read).

summary: Create a company
description: Only the name is required. Omit ownerId for the caller, send null for nobody; an owner who is not an active member is 422 COMPANY_OWNER_INVALID. Duplicate names are allowed, as in Reference.

summary: Delete several companies (audited; each emits company.deleted)
description: Unknown ids and ids outside the caller scope are listed in `failed`; they do not stop the rest. Contacts, deals and every other record that pointed at a company are kept and unlinked.

summary: Export companies as CSV (the list filters, the chosen columns, company properties included)
description: Same filters and order as the list, inside the caller export scope; at most 5000 companies (422 COMPANY_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE otherwise). `columns` is a comma separated list of built-in columns and `property:<key>`; omitted means all. Audited.

summary: Import companies from the text of a CSV file
description: Needs record.companies.create too. The header names the columns (name or website, email, phone, industry, size, address, notes, owner and any company property by label or key). Up to 1000 rows; each is checked like the form and a bad row is listed in `failed` with its line while the others are kept. With matchExisting a company with the same website (or name) has its blanks filled and nothing overwritten, inside the caller record.companies.update scope.

summary: The distinct industries typed so far, for the industry filter
Lightweight rows for pickers and typeaheads (Reference: GET companies/search)
description: Up to `limit` companies (default 20) whose name contains `q`, newest first.

summary: The tiles over the list: companies, with an open deal, won value
description: Same filters as the list, so the tiles follow the search box.

summary: A company's tasks (same filters and paging as the list)
description: Needs record.tasks.read, and record.companies.read on the company (its record scope applies: a company the caller cannot see is 404).

summary: Delete a company (audited; emits company.deleted)
description: Its contacts and deals are kept and unlinked, and so is everything else that pointed at it (tasks, projects, proposals, invoices, payments).

summary: Get one company by uuid, with its rollup
Update a company
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Absent keeps, null or an empty string clears; the name cannot be cleared.

summary: The company's activity: who changed what, newest first
description: Read from the audit trail: the create, each edit (field by field), contacts linked and unlinked.

summary: Whether a brief can be written, and the caller own latest brief of the company
description: `available` is false when no AI key is available to the workspace. `brief.stale` is true when the CRM changed since it was written. Calls no model.

summary: Write (or rewrite) the AI brief of a company
description: Facts are read as the caller (their record scopes) and sent without names, emails or phone numbers. The same facts within a day return the stored brief and call no model unless `regenerate` is true; a second generation within 30 seconds is 429 COMPANY_BRIEF_RATE_LIMITED. No AI key is 422 COMPANY_BRIEF_AI_UNAVAILABLE; a failing provider is 502 COMPANY_BRIEF_PROVIDER_FAILED and the previous brief is kept.

summary: A company's contacts (newest first, cursor paginated)
description: Needs record.contacts.read too, and its record scope applies: a contact the caller cannot see is not listed.

summary: Put existing contacts under the company
description: Needs record.contacts.update too (its record scope applies to each contact). A contact that belonged to another company moves. Unknown ids and contacts outside the caller scope are listed in `failed`; they do not stop the rest.

summary: Take a contact out of the company (the contact is kept)
description: 404 when the contact is not one of the company's contacts. Needs record.contacts.update too.

summary: Each baseline point and each requirement of a switched-on profile as built, partial or open
description: Worked out from the workspace data. It lists tools in place; it never says the workspace is compliant.

summary: The Do-Not-Call list: numbers that get no marketing by voice or SMS (newest first)
description: `q` matches a part of the number. The ConsentGate reads this list (reason `on_dnc_list`); WhatsApp, email and service messages are not held by it.

summary: Add numbers to the Do-Not-Call list
description: Up to 1000 numbers. Local numbers are read with `defaultCountryCode`. A number already listed is left as it is; an entry that is not a number is counted and sampled in the answer.

summary: Add the numbers of a CSV (text) to the Do-Not-Call list
description: The column named phone, mobile or number, else the first column. At most 90 KiB of text per request; the screen sends a bigger file in parts. 422 COMPLIANCE_DNC_INVALID for a file with no numbers column.

summary: Remove a number from the Do-Not-Call list (404 COMPLIANCE_DNC_NOT_FOUND)
The workspace privacy and terms links and default notice wording, for the form builder and the notice editor
Regime profiles, officer contacts, links, children flag, quiet hours and the country suggestion
description: `suggestion` is the profiles the billing (else onboarding) country suggests; nothing is switched on until a person saves. `regimesConfirmedAt` is null until then.

summary: Save the whole Compliance center settings document
description: Needs the rowVersion read (absent on the first save). 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT, 422 COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS_INVALID. A non-empty `regimes` confirms the profile choice.

summary: The workspace sub-processor list
Add a sub-processor (409 COMPLIANCE_SUBPROCESSOR_DUPLICATE for a name already listed)
Remove a sub-processor from the list
Change a sub-processor (needs the rowVersion read)
The video options and calendar the Add meeting form may offer this person
description: A video option is listed only when it is installed AND connected: Zoom or Teams (the workspace installed the listing and this person connected their own account), Teams through the Microsoft calendar, Google Meet through the Google calendar. An empty list means the form shows no video row; `canInstall`, `connectable` and `installable` decide whether it shows one quiet link to the integrations page.

summary: This person's Zoom and Teams connections
description: `not_installed`: the workspace has not installed the listing. `unavailable`: the platform has no OAuth app for it. `needs_reconnect`: the provider no longer honours the grant.

summary: Disconnect this person's Zoom or Teams account
description: Deletes the stored tokens (the provider has no way to withdraw consent for an app: the person removes it in their account). Rooms already made stay; moving or deleting those meetings cannot reach them any more. Idempotent.

summary: Confirm a connection the provider sent the browser back from

description: 422 FLB_IMPORT_INVALID when there is no flowNodes array; 422 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED at the plan cap.

description: Counts ignore the list filters.

summary: Take a tag off a conversation (a tag not on it is a no-op)

Add an internal note (never sent to the customer)

summary: Give a conversation back to the bot

summary: Mark a conversation as spam (from any status); taking it off spam is the status route (spam to open)

summary: Resolve, close, or reopen a conversation
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). A move the state machine does not allow is 422 CONVERSATION_STATUS_INVALID; the status the thread already has is a no-op.

summary: Put a tag on a conversation
description: Name it by `tagId` or by `name`. A name that does not exist yet creates the tag and needs `inbox.tag.manage` too (403 INBOX_LABEL_CREATE_FORBIDDEN). Putting on a tag already there is a no-op.

summary: Take a tag off a conversation (a tag not on it is a no-op)

Needs `mail.templates.read` and the right to reply to that conversation. Sends nothing and counts nothing: the agent reads it in the composer, and the use is counted when the reply is sent. 404 if the template or conversation is not yours to see, 422 EMAIL_TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED or CHANNEL_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED (not an email thread).

summary: Delete a tag (it leaves every conversation and contact)

description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise).

A paused form comes back `closed`. 404 for an unknown, archived or plan-locked key; 403 FORMS_ORIGIN_DENIED for a browser on an origin the form does not allow. Cached 30 seconds with an ETag.

summary: Analytics beacon: a view, a start, a step, a submit, a completion
description: Always 204 for a key that does not exist; a refused origin is still 403 and a rate limit 429. Nothing personal is stored.

summary: Where a submission's payment stands
description: For the page the visitor returns to from the gateway. `payment` is `awaiting_payment` until the gateway's verified notification arrives (the redirect back is never proof), then `paid` with the form's thank-you in `next`. The token is the receipt `submit` returned; 404 for any other.

summary: Send a submission
description: JSON only. `idempotencyKey` (made by the page, once per page load) makes a repeat the same submission: the stored answer comes back and nothing is written twice. 201 `{ submissionToken, next }` whatever happened to the submission. 422 FORMS_VALIDATION lists `{ path: fieldId, message: rule }` (the one case the sender learns specifics: it is their own input). 404 for an unknown, archived, paused or plan-locked key, 403 FORMS_ORIGIN_DENIED for a browser on a disallowed origin, 413 over the body cap, 415 for another content type, 429 over a rate limit.

summary: The invoice a buyer sees (JSON for the /i/<token> page); counts the view
description: Rate limited to 120 requests a minute per address. 404 unknown link, 410 INV_LINK_UNAVAILABLE revoked or expired.

summary: Pay now: bank-transfer instructions, or a payment attempt when an online connection is on
description: Display-only: it never marks the invoice paid. Only a verified webhook (or staff recording the transfer) does. 20 requests a minute per address.

summary: The invoice as a PDF
description: A pure render of the frozen invoice: it never triggers a send and counts no view.

summary: A printable HTML page of the invoice
Send a lead to a lead source
description: JSON object or form body. The token in the path is the only credential; if the source has a shared secret, send it in `X-Webhook-Secret`. Answers `{ ok: true, received: true }` whatever happened to the lead: it never says whether a contact existed. The same lead twice (same id, or the same body when the source has no id path) is acknowledged and not repeated. 404 for an unknown, paused or malformed token, 401 for a wrong secret, 413 over the body cap, 415 for another content type, 429 over the rate limit.

summary: Web app manifest (404 while installable-app support is off)
Active FAQs for a public placement
robots.txt from the SEO settings
The document as the buyer sees it
description: First open of a sent document marks it viewed (timeline + salesdoc.viewed). `status` reads `expired` once the valid-until date has passed, even before the sweep marks it. No buyer email or phone is returned.

summary: Accept
description: Needs the signer name and the consent flag; an email and a drawn PNG signature are optional. Signer, IP, user agent and time are recorded in the timeline (encrypted at rest). The same call again is the same answer with `replay: true`; after a decline it is 409 SALESDOC_ALREADY_DECIDED; past the valid-until date 409 SALESDOC_EXPIRED.

summary: Decline, with an optional reason
description: Symmetric to accept; a decision is final until staff revise the document.

summary: Printable page (save as PDF from the browser); not counted as a view
Brand, defaults, theme, SEO, footer, cookie banner and tracker ids
Team Inbox app manifest (404 while that app is off)
Receive a signed payment event (generic HMAC webhook)
description: Header X-Invoice-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>"> with the connection secret; events older than 5 minutes are refused. 401 for any signature problem (unknown endpoint, disabled, no secret, wrong or stale signature are indistinguishable). Idempotent on the event id. Amount and currency must match the payment attempt.

summary: The shortcut tiles of the caller (the ten defaults until they customise)
Save the shortcut tiles of the caller (max 10, sanitised)
A one-time ticket for the socket handshake
description: Called by the web app's same-origin proxy with the session token. The ticket works once, for 60 seconds; a reconnect asks for a new one. Not an @Idempotent route on purpose: replaying a stored response would hand out a ticket that is already used.

summary: List recurring invoices (cursor paginated)
description: Filters: status (active, paused, ended), contactId.

summary: Create a schedule from a template or from an existing invoice
description: The template is validated and priced now. mode: draft (each invoice stays a draft), issue (numbered at once) or issue_send (issued and sent). A start date more than 12 periods back is 422 REC_START_TOO_OLD.

summary: Delete a schedule (invoices already generated stay)
Get one schedule, with its next five dates
Edit the schedule or replace the template for future invoices (rowVersion required)
Pause a schedule
Resume a paused schedule
description: Periods that fell while paused are skipped: the next invoice is for today or later.

summary: Generate the next period now
Run history: one row per generated (or failed) period, newest first
List proposals and estimates (cursor paginated, newest first)
description: Filters: kind, status (comma list), q (number, title, contact or company name), contactId, companyId, dealId, ownerId, mine, currency, validFrom/validTo (the calendar reads this).

summary: Create a proposal or an estimate (a draft)
description: The number comes from a locked per-type counter (PRO-0001 / EST-0001, configurable). The buyer defaults to the linked contact. A contact, company or deal outside the workspace is 404; an owner who is not an active member is 422 SALESDOC_OWNER_INVALID; a bad amount is 422 SALESDOC_AMOUNT_INVALID with one detail per field.

summary: Counts per status and the open value, for the tabs and the value tile
description: Same filters as the list without status and paging. `openValue` is sent, viewed and accepted-not-converted, one total per currency.

summary: Numbering and defaults of proposals and estimates
description: Prefixes, padding, starting numbers, the default validity and the link lifetime, plus the counters (the next number is last + 1). `rowVersion` is null until the first save.

summary: Change numbering and defaults
description: Shapes the NEXT numbers only (an issued number never changes and the counter is never lowered). The first save carries no rowVersion; later ones must carry the version read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT).

summary: Templates of default terms and notes (the default of a kind first)
Create a template
description: Making it the default clears the flag on the previous default of its kind. A name is unique per kind (409 SALESDOC_TEMPLATE_NAME_TAKEN).

summary: Delete a template (documents already made from it keep their text)
Edit a template (requires the rowVersion read)
Delete a document (audited; emits salesdoc.deleted)
description: Accepted and converted documents are evidence: 409 SALESDOC_NOT_DELETABLE. A deleted number is never reused.

summary: Get one document with its lines, totals, link state and the actions its status allows
Edit a draft (whole document: fields, links, pricing, lines)
description: Requires the rowVersion read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT). Only a draft is edited in place: any other status is 409 SALESDOC_NOT_EDITABLE (revise it). Absent keeps, null clears. `lines` replaces every line. A new currency needs the lines in the same call.

summary: Record that the buyer accepted (a signed copy, a phone call)
description: From draft, sent or viewed. Recorded in the timeline as staff-recorded. An open document past its valid-until date is 409 SALESDOC_EXPIRED (extend it first).

summary: Create a deal from the document and link it
description: The deal takes the document's title, total, currency, contact, company and owner, in the chosen (default) pipeline's first stage. 409 SALESDOC_ALREADY_LINKED_DEAL when a deal is linked.

summary: Turn an accepted document into an invoice draft (through the invoicing port, in one transaction)
description: Only an accepted document converts (409 SALESDOC_INVALID_TRANSITION otherwise); twice is 409 SALESDOC_ALREADY_CONVERTED. 501 SALESDOC_INVOICING_UNAVAILABLE until the invoicing module binds SALES_DOC_INVOICE_PORT.

summary: Record that the buyer declined
Duplicate into a new draft (optionally as the other kind)
description: New number and link; the lines, pricing, buyer and terms are copied; nothing of the sending history. Needs read on the original.

summary: Timeline: every transition, send, view, decision and edit (newest first, cursor paginated)
description: Buyer decisions carry the signer, IP and user agent (encrypted at rest). The drawn signature is on the single-event route.

summary: One timeline event, with the buyer's drawn signature when there is one
Give an open or expired document a new valid-until date
description: An expired document is open again (viewed when the buyer had opened it, else sent). The date cannot be in the past.

summary: The share link (token, web path and absolute url)
description: The token is stored hashed for lookup and encrypted for this read. A bearer secret: anyone holding it can open the document.

summary: A new link; the old one stops working at once
description: `expiresInDays` sets this link's own lifetime (null: none); absent uses the workspace default.

summary: Revoke the link: the buyer gets 410 SALESDOC_LINK_UNAVAILABLE until a new one is made or the document is sent again
note: skipped: would invalidate the test session or change credentials

summary: Printable page (save as PDF from the browser)
description: A self-contained print-optimised HTML page (A4, no scripts). A server-side PDF file is a listed follow-up.

summary: Back to a draft to change what was sent (revision + 1, the old content is kept)
description: From sent, viewed, declined or expired. Accepted and converted documents are final: duplicate them instead.

summary: The earlier revisions of a document (kept when it was revised), newest first
The lines and totals a document had in one earlier revision
Send the document: email now, ask for WhatsApp, or mark it sent for a link you share yourself
description: `email` mails the link (502 SALESDOC_SEND_FAILED leaves the document unchanged; 422 SALESDOC_NO_RECIPIENT without an address). `whatsapp` marks it sent and emits salesdoc.delivery_requested for the messaging side to deliver (TODO: that adapter belongs to the messaging domain). `link` is the copy-link / mark-as-sent path. A draft becomes sent; a sent or viewed one is re-sent (status kept); anything else is 409 SALESDOC_INVALID_TRANSITION. Needs an Idempotency-Key.

summary: List sales orders (cursor paginated)
description: Filters: status, invoicingStatus (not_invoiced, partially_invoiced, invoiced), fulfilmentStatus, contactId, dealId, q.

summary: Create a sales order from an accepted offer (quoteId) or from lines
description: A draft until confirmed. An offer that is not accepted is 409 SO_QUOTE_NOT_ACCEPTED; one that already has a live order is 409 SO_QUOTE_TAKEN.

summary: Counts per status, orders waiting to be invoiced or delivered, and the open value per currency
Delete a draft order
Get one sales order, with its lines, progress and invoices
Edit a draft order (rowVersion required)
Cancel an order that has no live invoice (409 SO_HAS_INVOICES otherwise)
Confirm a draft: its prices are frozen, it can be invoiced and delivered
Record a delivery of some or all quantities
Invoice part or all of the order
description: Returns { order, invoice }. A draft invoice unless issue is true. Quantities above what is left are 422 SO_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS; shipping is billed with the first invoice. Voiding or deleting the invoice gives its quantities back.

summary: Scheduled messages with tab counts, search and the next one due
Create a schedule (one per sender when the audience is split)
How many people a draft audience would reach, and how many were left out
Upload the file a schedule sends; returns its id for the schedule and a link to look at it
description: 422 for a type or content the upload policy refuses, and when media storage is local disk (nothing the provider could fetch).

summary: What the composer offers: senders, groups, tags, earlier broadcasts and templates
One schedule with its recipients and progress
Change a schedule that has not started: any field of the composer, with the version that was opened
description: 409 for a stale version, a schedule that is not waiting or paused, or a one-off that has begun.

summary: The composer prefilled with a schedule that has not started (the edit screen)
description: 409 when the schedule is no longer waiting or paused, or a one-off has begun sending.

summary: Queued, sent, delivered, read and failed over time, from the stored recipient statuses
The recipients of a schedule, filtered by status and search, a page at a time
Give a failed schedule a new time; failed recipients are tried again, sent ones are not
List the segments the caller can see (newest first)
description: Counts are the cached ones; a list never counts. Private segments are visible to their owner and to callers who can edit every segment; `specific` ones also to the people and teams they are shared with.

summary: Create a segment
description: Rules that point at a tag, group, stage, status, user or property that does not exist are 422 SEG_RULES_INVALID. A name another segment has is 409 SEG_NAME_TAKEN. With visibility `specific`, `sharedWith` must name at least one person or team of this workspace (422 SEG_SHARE_EMPTY / SEG_SHARE_USER_NOT_FOUND / SEG_SHARE_TEAM_NOT_FOUND).

summary: Save the current contacts filter as a segment
description: The filter is converted to rules (AND of its parts); a filter with no conditions is 422.

summary: Count and first 10 contacts for a set of rules, without saving
description: Rate limited per user. Counting stops after 3 seconds and answers `countApproximate: true`. Needs record.contacts.read.

summary: Segments that use a tag, group, stage, status, property or user
description: The warning to show before deleting one of them.

summary: Delete a segment (its contacts are untouched: it never owned them)
Get one segment with its member count
description: The count is cached for 5 minutes and computed under a 3 second ceiling (`countApproximate`). `invalidConditions` lists conditions whose tag, group, stage, status, user or property was deleted: they match nothing.

summary: Update a segment
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Callers with an `own` scope may edit only segments they own. `sharedWith`, when sent, replaces the people list; sharing never grants edit rights.

summary: Copy the current members into a group (a snapshot)
description: More than 1000 members are added by a background job in chunks: the answer is `queued: true` with `changed: 0`.

summary: The contacts in a segment (cursor paginated)
description: Same query, filters and `expand` as GET /contacts: it is GET /contacts?segmentId=:id.

summary: Export the members as CSV
description: The contacts export, over the segment. At most 200,000 rows.

summary: Recount the members now (rate limited) and store the count
Tag every current member (a snapshot)
description: By tagId or by name (a new name creates the tag: needs record.tags.create and counts against the plan). Contacts that join the segment later are not tagged.

summary: Run all six install steps in order in one call; the last one locks setup
The deployment's own database connection, without its password
Server requirements check (runtime, services, directories, database)
Run one of the six install steps (idempotent; order enforced here)
Is first-run setup open, and is the server ready for it
Test a database connection (422 with the server message on failure)
Verify the purchase code (only on deployments that enforce one)
Check the setup token before the form is filled in
Active announcements, grouped into one bar per tone
Navigation mode, rail colours, top bar entries and whether the tour runs
Top-bar layout every customer sees (bar order and the More zone)
The bell's Clear all: delete my notifications
The More hub: live counters for the strip, the tool cards and the plan card
My preferences (auto AI summarize)
Save my preferences
My pinned shortcuts (the ten defaults until I customise)
Pin up to ten shortcuts: catalogue keys or custom links
description: Unknown keys, blank labels and unsafe links are dropped, not rejected.

summary: The guided tour was finished or skipped; it never auto-runs again
Delete the workspace (owner only; needs the exact name and the password)
Workspace name, URL, timezone and currency (General tab)
Save the General tab (owner only; blank values are ignored)
Brand colours, logo and favicon (Branding tab)
Save the Branding tab (owner only): three #RRGGBB colours, a logo and a favicon
description: Absent fields are untouched; a blank colour clears it.

summary: Which translation providers may receive message text
Set no restriction, EU only or on-premise only (owner only)
Row counts shown on the export cards
Download contacts, conversations or messages as CSV (owner only)
description: Streamed in batches. An unknown type is 422.

summary: Sheets key status and webhook counts (API and webhooks tab)
The notification matrix: 18 events, 9 categories, Slack URL
Save the notification matrix (owner only)
The weekly working hours and holidays (General tab); the business hours the inbox, SLA and flows read
Save the working hours and holidays (owner only)
description: Seven days, each with a window and up to two extra windows; a closing time before the opening time is an overnight window; 24:00 closes at the end of the day. Holidays are closed all day and are kept when omitted.

summary: Whether the platform app is on, what it asks for, the webhook topics and the workspace’s store (never a token)
The address the browser is sent to so the merchant can approve the app on their store
description: 422 ECOM_SHOP_INVALID for a domain that is not `*.myshopify.com`; 422 ECOM_NOT_CONFIGURED when the platform app is off or has no client id.

summary: The app’s public client id, so the embedded page can load App Bridge
Which connected store an App Bridge session token belongs to, and its connection status
description: Read-only; nothing is signed in. 401 ECOM_SESSION_TOKEN_INVALID for a bad signature, an expired token, another app or another shop; 422 ECOM_NOT_CONFIGURED when the platform app is off. An unknown shop answers 200 with `connected = false`.

summary: Disconnect the store: its webhooks are removed and the row goes with its mapping and logs
Every event the Shopify store can fire, with its automation (off when never set up)
Save the Shopify store’s automations in one step
description: Unknown event types are ignored. An automation that is on needs a template. `senderKey` is ignored.

summary: Everything the Shopify store screen shows, from the CRM mirror, in one read
Whether the Shopify store’s orders are invoiced on their own, and on which event
Change the Shopify invoicing switch and trigger; what is left out stays
description: Audited with the workspace’s invoice settings. 404 for another workspace’s store.

summary: Send one template to a contact group with a product and a coupon (Shopify)
description: 200 `{ok, total, queued}`; `ok: false` with a message for an unknown template or an empty audience. The sends run in the background.

summary: Sync now: read the store again, refresh its facts, queue the import and return its totals
description: 200 with `ok = false` and the reason when the store does not answer (it is then flagged `error`); 404 for another workspace’s store.

summary: Win-back: message customers by last order, order count and spend (Shopify)
description: Opted-out numbers are skipped. Same answer as the offer.

summary: Is this number a mobile, a landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)? Always 200 with a sentence
The workspace's SMS senders, oldest first (never any key)
Verify the provider keys, then connect an SMS sender
description: 422 SMS_CREDENTIALS_REJECTED when the provider refuses the keys (nothing is saved). The same From value updates its sender. Twilio: blank `accountSid` / `authToken` reuse the keys of the workspace's Twilio WhatsApp connection. MSG91: the key is `authToken`.

summary: Remove a sender and its keys (an unknown id changes nothing)
Activate or deactivate a sender (keys are kept); 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT when stale
List status options for a module, optionally one group
Add a status option to a group
Reorder options within a group
How many contacts hold each option of a group
Delete a status option
description: Contacts that still hold the value make it 409 STATUS_OPTION_IN_USE (errors[0].message = how many) until repeated with moveTo=<another option id of the group>; they are moved in the same transaction.

summary: Update a status option
description: Requires the rowVersion you read. A mismatch returns 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT.

summary: Which shop a host serves
description: A verified custom domain, else `<slug>.<STOREFRONT_HOST>` in subdomain mode. 404 when the host serves no shop.

summary: Provider payment notification for a workspace gateway
description: 404 `gateway_unknown`, 403 `webhook_secret_not_configured`, 400 `bad_signature`. A reference no domain owns, or an event that is not a payment, is answered 200 `ignored`.

summary: Razorpay payment-link webhook
description: Header `X-Razorpay-Signature`. 400 `bad_signature` / `invalid_json`, 404 `storefront_unknown`. An order of another shop, a different amount or currency, or a cancelled order is answered 200 with `order: null` and `rejected`.

summary: Abandoned-cart beacon
description: `scheduled` is false when recovery is off, the workspace has no sender, or an active recovery exists. 30 a minute per address.

summary: Place an order
description: Ids and quantities only: prices come from the database. Optional `Idempotency-Key` header: a repeat returns the first order. 422 `STORE_ITEMS_UNAVAILABLE` when nothing is left to buy; an unknown coupon code is ignored. 20 a minute per address.

summary: Quote a coupon against the cart
description: 422 `STORE_COUPON_INVALID` for every reason alike. 30 a minute per address.

summary: The shop home: shop block, 48 products per page, facets
description: 404 `STORE_NOT_AVAILABLE` for an unknown or disabled shop. Page 1 counts as a visit.

summary: The tracking page of an order; the token is the only access control
A product page: product, related, approved reviews
Submit a product review (stored pending)
description: 422 "Unknown product." for a product of another workspace. 10 a minute per address.

summary: Discount codes, newest first; search by code, filter by state
Create a discount code
description: The code is stored upper case; 409 `STORE_COUPON_CODE_TAKEN` when a code equal ignoring case exists. A percentage is clamped to 100.

summary: Delete a discount code (orders that used it keep the code text)
One discount code
Edit a discount code (the whole form, guarded by rowVersion)
description: 409 `ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT` for a stale form, 409 `STORE_COUPON_CODE_TAKEN` for a code another coupon holds.

summary: Switch a discount code on or off
The orders that used the code, newest first
Every buyer (saved customers and order-only buyers) by last activity, with order count and lifetime total; search name, phone, company
Save a customer by phone (creates or updates, as Reference)
description: 422 when the phone has no digits. Answers 200 with the customer either way.

summary: Remove a saved customer (their orders are kept)
One customer (profile uuid or phone:<digits>) with totals, recent orders and the linked contact
Edit name, company and address (the phone is the key and stays); an order-only buyer gets their profile created
Saved gateways (workspace default and shop overrides); credentials come back masked, never in clear
The driver catalogue: every gateway, the fields it needs, and whether this build can charge with it
The gateway a checkout (with storefrontId) or an invoice (without) would use now, and where it came from
Remove a saved gateway and its credentials
Save a gateway: create or change it for the workspace or one shop
description: A blank credential keeps the stored one; `clear` removes named fields; unknown field keys are 422. Secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned.

summary: Make a gateway the default of its scope
description: 422 `STORE_GATEWAY_NOT_CONFIGURED` when it is switched off or a required field is empty.

summary: Check the saved keys. Razorpay and Stripe are verified with the provider; the others only for required fields.
Enable or disable a saved gateway
Groups the connected number belongs to, most recently synced first; search by subject
The cards: groups, groups with a code, and the ordering number
One group
Set or clear a group ordering code
description: 409 `STORE_GROUP_CODE_TAKEN` when another group holds the code; a blank code clears it.

summary: Orders, newest first: filter by status, source, shop, payment status, date range, phone / name / order number
The status tabs: one count per status and the total
Delete an order and its lines
One order: lines, totals, address, coupon, payments, history and the gateways it can be paid with
Turn the order into a sales order and an invoice
description: Refused with the plan problem codes when the plan lacks invoicing or is out of invoices (PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED, PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED), and with 409 for a cancelled order. Answers the existing invoice when the order has one.

summary: Create a hosted payment link on the shop gateway (or the one named) and send it to the buyer
description: 422 `STORE_GATEWAY_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `STORE_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE`, 502 `STORE_PAYMENT_LINK_FAILED`.

summary: Save a payment link on the order and send it to the buyer
Change the status (any status to any), with notes and a payment link
description: Send the `rowVersion` you read (409 `ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT` otherwise). The buyer is messaged on WhatsApp when the status changed or a link was typed; `notified` says whether that went out.

summary: Store dashboard: 30-day KPIs, sales by day, best sellers, newest orders
description: `shopId` picks the shop the page is about (default: the most recently updated). 404 `STORE_NO_SHOP` when the workspace has no shop yet.

summary: Payment records of store orders (money asked for or received), newest first. Read only.
Orders by payment status and the money collected per currency
WhatsApp Pay configurations (the Direct Pay Method names)
Save a WhatsApp Pay configuration by name (creates or updates)
Remove a WhatsApp Pay configuration
The shop wizard: shops (newest first), connected devices, hasSender
Create a shop
description: The address is derived from the name (`-2`, `-3` when taken). 422 `STORE_NO_SENDER` without a connected WhatsApp number, 422 `STORE_DEVICE_INVALID` for a device that is not a connected one of this workspace.

summary: Clear every shop, order and product of the workspace
description: Needs `{"confirm":"yes"}`, else 422 `STORE_RESET_NOT_CONFIRMED`. Products are deleted permanently.

summary: Delete a shop and its orders; products stay
One shop with its settings
Wizard edit: name, custom domain, sending device
description: The address never changes. Changing the domain resets it to unverified. A wizard save re-enables the shop (a Reference quirk, kept).

summary: Storefront design page: theme, address, brand, shipping, payment, cart recovery, live switch
description: Send the `rowVersion` you read (409 `ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT` otherwise). 409 `STORE_SLUG_TAKEN` for an address another shop owns. A blank Razorpay secret keeps the stored one; a provider other than `razorpay_api` drops the keys. Secrets are never returned.

summary: Check the shop's custom domain CNAME
description: The result is stored every time. 422 `STORE_DOMAIN_NOT_SET` when the shop has no custom domain.

summary: My newest tickets plus open/resolved counts
File a support ticket
One of my tickets with its thread (internal notes never included)
Reply on my ticket (reopens a resolved one)
List tags (cursor paginated)
Create a tag
Attach tags to contacts
description: Idempotent per (contact, tag) pair. Partial failure reported per contact id.

summary: Delete a tag (removes it from every contact it was on)
Update a tag
description: Requires the rowVersion you read. A mismatch returns 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT.

summary: List task outcomes in order (activeOnly=true for a picker)
description: Each outcome carries the number of tasks that use it.

summary: Add a task outcome
description: A name another outcome already has (ignoring case) is 409 TASK_OUTCOME_NAME_TAKEN. It goes last.

summary: Reorder the task outcomes (send every id once)
description: Anything but every id exactly once is 422 TASK_OUTCOME_ORDER_INVALID.

summary: Delete a task outcome
description: An outcome that tasks still carry is 409 TASK_OUTCOME_IN_USE: hide it instead.

summary: Rename or hide/show a task outcome
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). A hidden outcome is not offered in pickers but stays on its tasks.

summary: List tasks (cursor paginated)
description: Open tasks by default, soonest due first (undated last). Filters: status, due (overdue | today | upcoming | none, cut in the workspace time zone), dueFrom/dueTo, priority, mine, assigneeId, unassigned, contactId, dealId, companyId, q (title). Sort: due | created | completed.

summary: Create a task
description: Omit the assignee for the caller, send null for nobody. An assignee who is not an active member is 422 TASK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID; a contact, deal or company that is not in the workspace is 404. A deal brings its contact and company unless named.

summary: Assign several tasks to one member (or unassign them with null)
description: A bad assignee fails the call with 422 TASK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID before any task changes.

summary: Complete several tasks
description: Unknown ids and ids outside the caller scope are listed in `failed`; they do not stop the rest. Tasks that are already done succeed without an event.

summary: Delete several tasks (audited; each emits task.deleted)
Reopen several done tasks
Counts per bucket for the tab badges
description: overdue / today / upcoming / noDate partition the open tasks inside the filter; `done` counts completed ones; `mine` is the caller's own open and overdue count.

summary: My tasks: the list filtered to tasks assigned to the caller
description: Same query as the list; `mine` is forced on.

summary: Delete a task (audited; emits task.deleted)
Get one task by uuid
Update a task
description: Requires the rowVersion you read (409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Absent keeps, null clears. A new dueAt arms the reminder again. Status changes through complete / reopen.

summary: Mark a task done (a no-op when it already is)
Link or unlink a contact, a deal and a company
description: Absent keeps, null unlinks. No rowVersion: last write wins.

summary: Reopen a done task (it can be reminded again)
List tax rates (default first)
description: active=true lists only the rates that can be picked today (active and inside their effective dates).
